note: HTTP 200 whose body is an error object instead of choices — one of OpenRouter's teeth. Reading this as EmptyResponse records the wrong code in the attempt trail AND skips the breaker, because EmptyResponse is deliberately not breaker-eligible, so a provider returning these all day would never be taken out of rotation. There is no status to classify on, which is why `_classify` reads the body's own code first. Note the code is an INTEGER.
